qrList.label: Delete Failed Messages
qrList.title: Deletes swipes that have no text content
qrList.message:
/messages names=off {{lastMessageId}} |
/setvar key=Message |

/if left={{getvar::Message}} rule=eq right="*Please provide text to format*" {: /echo "Blank message deleted" | /delswipe :} |

/if left={{getvar::Message}} rule=eq right="" {: /echo "Blank message deleted" | /delswipe :} |

/flushvar Message |

qrList.label: Summarize Chat
qrList.title: Summarizes the current chat
qrList.message:
/preset |
/setvar key=CurrentPreset |

/preset "Summarizer" ||

/wi-list-entries "Colorful Tweaks" |
/map {{pipe}} {:
	/setlorefield file="Colorful Tweaks" uid={{var::index}} field=disable true ||
:} ||

/wi-list-entries Preferences |
/map {{pipe}} {:
	/setlorefield file="Preferences" uid={{var::index}} field=disable true ||
:} ||

/summarize source=main quiet=false |

/preset {{getvar::CurrentPreset}} |

/wi-list-entries "Colorful Tweaks" |
/map {{pipe}} {:
	/setlorefield file="Colorful Tweaks" uid={{var::index}} field=disable false ||
:} ||

/wi-list-entries Preferences |
/map {{pipe}} {:
	/setlorefield file="Preferences" uid={{var::index}} field=disable false ||
:} ||

/flushvar CurrentPreset |
